description: This file defines TypeScript types and re-exports functions and constants related to setting up provider plugins for local or self-hosted models in an OpenClaw project.

methods.name: applyProviderDefaultModel
methods.description: Applies default model settings to a provider configuration.

methods.name: configureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderNonInteractive
methods.description: Configures a self-hosted provider in a non-interactive mode.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleLocalModels
methods.description: Discovers local models compatible with OpenAI API.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Discovers self-hosted providers compatible with OpenAI API.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Prompts user and configures self-hosted provider.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderAuth
methods.description: Prompts user for authentication and configures self-hosted provider.
